premises.text: Antimicrobial resistance is a top global health threat
premises.evidence_span: The World Health Organization says that antimicrobial resistance is a top 10 global health threat in the world facing humanity.

premises.text: Phage therapy can be a precise alternative to antibiotics
premises.evidence_span: Phages are microbes that infect bacteria. You can think of them like antibiotics, except they're natural and they're precise.

premises.text: A testing platform is necessary to understand the effectiveness of phage-based treatments
premises.evidence_span: we recognized was that if we were going to bring a precision serum or solution to market, we better have a test.

premises.text: Whole genome sequencing provides comprehensive data on the skin microbiome
premises.evidence_span: we amassed the largest database on the skin microbiome to date using whole genome sequencing.

premises.text: Different areas of the skin may have different microbiome compositions
premises.evidence_span: your forehead microbiome might be very well different than your chin microbiome.

premises.text: Phage production requires a biobank of diverse strains and advanced technology
premises.evidence_span: We produce phages by leveraging our biobanks of over 10,000 bacterial, phage, and fungal strains.

premises.text: Parallel has a significant waitlist and potential for high revenue growth
premises.evidence_span: Parallel has a waitlist of over 6,000 people, five patents pending, and an LOI from a Fortune 500 company to develop novel ingredients.

value.text: Phage therapy can provide a safer and more effective treatment for bacterial infections
value.evidence_span: they're like precise assassins that kill the bad bacteria, but leave the good bacteria alone.

notes: Traction metrics and investor details excluded as they do not support premises.
